universal_patterns.pattern: this chapter applies to all agencies

proposal.rationale: The 10 undetermined sections are all from Title 9 (Elections), chapter 141 — not occupational licensing. They use "as used in this title" referring to the Elections title, not an occupational title. These are not occupational licensing sections and should remain undetermined/excluded from the umbrella scope rather than being force-classified as universal. Keeping the patterns as-is: CT section format "N-NN" with the chapter token before the dash, standard "chapter NNN" cites, and standard licensed-under triggers. No changes needed — these sections genuinely fall outside the occupational licensing umbrella.
